texts.preamble: Oleti Balaji vs State Of A.P., Rep By P.P on 2 November, 2018 Hon'Ble Sri Justice Dr. B. Siva Sankara Rao
texts.facts: It is also referred in the private complaint for the cognizance taken therefrom Section 16(1A)(i) of the Act punishable for the offences committed under 7(i) and (2) (ia) (j) of the Act in relation to Parley Chocolate with no shell life provided.
texts.arguments: The main contention in the quash petition is the Section 16 [(1A) and (1A)(i) which reads as follows: (1A) If any person whether by himself or by any other person on his behalf, imports into India or manufactures for sale, or stores, sells or distributes,-- (i) any article of food which is adulterated within the meaning of any of the sub-clauses (e) to (l) (both inclusive) of clause (ia) of section 2; What was mentioned in 16(1A)(i) among Sections 2(e) to (i) which reads as follows:- (e) if the article had been prepared, packed or kept under insanitary conditions whereby it has become contaminated or injurious to health; (f) if the article consists wholly or in part of any filthy, putrid, 3[***], rotten, decomposed or diseased animal or vegetable substance or is insect-infested or is otherwise unfit for human consumption; 1[***], rotten, decomposed or diseased animal or vegetable substance or is insect-infested or is otherwise unfit for human consumption;" (g) if the article is obtained from a diseased animal; (h) if the article contains any poisonous or other ingredient which renders it injurious to health; (i) if the container of the article is composed, whether wholly or in part, of any poisonous or deleterious substance which renders its contents injurious to health; In fact, none of the ingredients above are applicable to the case on hand undisputedly. Oleti Balaji vs State Of A.P., Rep By P.P on 2 November, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138706261/ 1 Section 16(1A) (ii) speaks any adulterant which is injurious to health, for that section 2(j) that is applicable which speaks "if any colouring matter other than that prescribed in respect thereof is present in the article, or if the amounts of the prescribed colouring matter which is present in the article are not within the prescribed limits of variability".
